semantic_policy.field_code: Lowercase ASCII identity of an explicitly allowlisted source key; not a display label, row identifier or inferred value.
semantic_policy.unit_basis: public_contract marks a unit printed by the reviewed SPA; source marks a source-supplied unit column. Neither silently supplies a missing historical unit.
semantic_policy.date_roles: Emit only the fixed meanings defined in source_metadata.go; ambiguous source dates remain unknown. Explicit administrative periods never become disease or medication-use periods.
semantic_policy.source_registry_scope: 59 supplemental provider category projections with source windows, including both annual detail lists, top-level-array preventive reads and 40 separately acquired care-chart selectors. Every one of the 215 current lazy chunks is pinned for drift. Public asset coverage is not proof of account or lifetime data completeness; principal medical/document and nested custom projections have their separate source review and focused fixtures.
semantic_policy.field_path_declarations: Dotted and [] paths in custom-read declarations describe reviewed nested source fields; they are not copied as arbitrary public field codes.
semantic_policy.chart_series: Source care charts are acquired independently through fixed selectors and session-bound case references. Matching table fields are not treated as evidence of identical source rowsets. Raw values retain source precision; missing units stay missing.
